native provider independence, optional evidence/adaptive foundations and
validated EN/PT documentation. Experimental flags remain disabled by default.

Source: merge PR57, 8f688e26f0c4570b6a2b30c7e052672f102703f3.
Reviewed tree: ce778501a664b7639e26a4274bba339d11e52710.
Final candidate CI40814231189: 16 distinct successful jobs, attempt1.
Restricted official-client/Core fake-provider qualification: 4 passing events,
zero failures/skips, without subscription authentication or real-model inference.

Publication requires the existing Release workflow gates. Downloaded assets
must be independently verified after publication. Global economic acceptance,
general client/admin parity and Context synchronization remain incomplete.
Benchmark PR56, route-guard preparation and connector-restart PR63 are excluded.
